verdict.rationale: Zep documents RBAC for dashboard users, ABAC policies scoped to API keys and UserGroups for least-privilege agent/MCP access, and both Audit Logs (dashboard activity) and API Logs (request activity) — directly matching the roles/policies/ACL + audit requirement. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of governance features, and no detail on granularity of ACLs (e.g., per-thread or per-node permissions) beyond high-level docs.
